items.briefing:
The Akira ransomware group is actively exploiting a two-year-old vulnerability in SonicWall network devices, according to new research from ThreatDown. If your organisation uses SonicWall equipment and hasn't applied security updates recently, this is urgent — attackers are using this known flaw to break into networks. Check with your IT team today to confirm your SonicWall devices are fully patched.

Separately, a survey found younger Australian parents are among the most anxious about AI use, reflecting growing community concern about how these tools affect families. Organisations should be mindful of this when communicating about AI adoption internally or with clients.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT team to confirm all network devices — not just computers — are running the latest security updates.
